{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check if any revenue values are suspiciously high (e.g., 999999.99)
print("Number of rows with revenue = 999999.99:")
print((df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum())

# Check for refunded orders (they should not be counted in conversion rate if we want completed-only conversion)
print("\nStatus distribution:")
print(df['status'].value_counts())"}
